title: On release day an untouched A/P report shows the same rows and amounts
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Before the release was installed, you took screenshots (and, for A/P, any print or export there was) of the three A/P reports for {Date-A}, untouched.
    For example: {Date-A} is the day before the release.
  • Starting screen: the release is installed; Reports (top menu; its left menu lists the A/R reports under ACCOUNTS RECEIVABLE and the A/P reports under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, with {Date-A} chosen as the as-of date on each report as you open it.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Open A/P Summary from the Reports menu without touching any filter, and compare its rows, amounts and Totals with the screenshot of A/P Summary taken before the release.
  2. Open A/P Detail from the Reports menu without touching any filter, and compare its rows, amounts and Totals with the screenshot of A/P Detail taken before the release.
  3. Open A/P Unpaid Invoices from the Reports menu without touching any filter, and compare its rows, amounts and Totals with the screenshot of A/P Unpaid Invoices taken before the release.
  4. Read the Location chip on each report.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the same vendors and the same amounts, shown the same way (same $ sign, commas, two decimals and credit format); only the order may differ.
  • Step 2: the same documents and the same amounts, shown the same way (same $ sign, commas, two decimals and credit format); only the order may differ.
  • Step 3: the same documents and the same amounts, shown the same way (same $ sign, commas, two decimals and credit format); only the order may differ.
  • Step 4: "Location: All locations" on all three: an untouched report is the organization-wide report it was before.

A customer with an overpaid invoice may show a different A/R Summary Totals row after the release; the PRD names this as a change (16 invoices across 13 customer accounts in production).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • What changes for existing users: “Which rows and amounts each user can see is unchanged: an untouched report shows exactly today's organization-wide numbers (apart from the Totals rows noted above), and the reports show money exactly as they do today.”
  • S5-R5: “The filter opens with every location in the list ticked (All locations), so an untouched report shows exactly today's organization-wide rows and totals. "Select all" ticks every location again.”
  • Key Decisions, organization-wide: “The reports stay organization-wide, by decision. Everyone with access sees every location's data, as today; the Location filter only narrows. Rationale: no permission changes in this release (decided 2026-10-15). Rejected: restricting the reports to the locations a user is enrolled in, which would be its own announced permissions change later.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "A/R and A/P Report Sorting" (https://claude.ai/artifact/BRYCdjKwGRSgGPC9xxkgF4), read 22 Oct 2026: page 4 "Location filter and Location column" (board Location.dc.html). Compare the screen with the pictures below at 100% zoom; the expected results still come from the PRD quotes above, the pictures give the look and the on-screen labels.

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • ar-ap-p4-opens-on-all-locations.png: figure "Opens on All locations" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"
  • ar-ap-p4-the-native-location-menu.png: figure "The native Location menu" (This build (after)), board "4. Location filter and Location column"

The design's own words:

  • "Native filter row: As of, Customer, Past due, then Location, which opens on "Location: All locations". Untouched, the report matches today. Column labelled "Location", after Date. S5-R1, S5-R2, S5-R5, S6-R1 to S6-R3." (caption of "Opens on All locations")
  • ""Select all" with "2 selected", every location in this report's own data named as in the top-right switcher, then "Clear selection". S5-R2, S5-R3, S5-R4, S5-R5, S5-R6." (caption of "The native Location menu")
